>
[Ventriloquist's Ring](/Equipment.aspx?ID=468)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 617 <sup>4.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This elegant copper ring has miniature images of songbirds engraved around its circumference. You gain a +1 item bonus to Deception checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Twisting the ring around your finger allows you to magically throw your voice, with the effects of a [_ventriloquism_](/Spells.aspx?ID=356) spell (DC 19).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
